     Phosphorus. The Element.

     Introduced by Hahnemann and proved by himself, Coullon, Gross, Hering, Schreter, Stapf, Hartlaub, etc. Toxicological reports are very numerous. See Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 7, p. 366.

     Provings of Amorphous Phosphorus by H. N. Martin. See Hah. Mo., vol. 12, p. 353 and Tr. H. M. Soc., Pa., 1874-8, p. 174.
